ev.q: The series mixes conventional 2D animation with 3D computer graphics
Galactik Football is set in the far future
a sport analogous to association football, but played seven to a side
the inhabited worlds of the Zaelion Galaxy compete in Galactik Football
a mystical energy, specific for every planet
the story follows the fate of an inexperienced Galactik Football team
It originally aired from 3 June 2006 to 27 October 2011
